headline: HT Media submits SEBI dematerialisation compliance certificate for Q2 FY27
summary: HT Media has filed its SEBI dematerialisation compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The filing is a standard regulatory requirement for listed entities in India. It confirms the status of physical share dematerialisation with depositories during the quarter. Indian retail investors can access this procedural document through public exchange disclosures.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock price
